intro.title: Rooftop Bites & Cocktails, Every Weekday
intro.body1: Happy hour runs Monday through Friday, 4:00–6:00 PM, on Coco Maya's elevated glass atrium patio in Little Italy. A dedicated menu of shareable bites and house cocktails, designed for the hour between the workday and the evening.
intro.body2: Walk-ins are welcome during happy hour. Reservations are recommended if you're bringing a group.
intro.imageAlt: Happy hour cocktails on the rooftop patio at Coco Maya
